name: Force Ray
body:
School evocation [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a glass cone or prism)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A glowing ray of force springs from your hand. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. The ray deals 1d4 points of force damage per caster level (maximum 25d4) and dazes the target for 1d6 rounds. A successful Fortitude save negates the dazing effect.
